items.docs: This API operation removes an explicitly granted permission for a specific group from a Bitbucket repository. It targets a particular group identified by its slug within a repository (specified by workspace and repository slug) and deletes the permission configuration that was directly assigned to that group. This endpoint is useful when you need to revoke repository access rights that were previously granted to a team or group, requiring authentication and appropriate administrative privileges.
